name: Rose Medical
old_description: Rose Medical specializes in crafting high-quality cannulas, catheters, and custom medical devices, offering a comprehensive range of manufacturing capabilities:
about:
Rose Medical is headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan. The company was founded in 1998 as Rose Technologies, initially focusing on manufacturing and quality‑assurance testing equipment for medical devices. It secured its first production contract in 2000 and moved to its current facility in 2003, where it built its first cleanroom.

Today Rose Medical operates as a full‑service medical device contract manufacturer specializing in catheters and finished devices. Its in‑house capabilities span tip forming, catheter lamination, wire‑reinforced cannula production, balloon forming, injection molding, laser processing, PTFE forming, silicone molding, dip molding, assembly, and sterile barrier packaging. The company runs multiple ISO Class 7 cleanrooms at its Grand Rapids site and opened a second manufacturing location in 2024 to add injection molding, laser processing, and other value‑added processes. An internal CNC machine shop supports custom automation equipment.

Rose Medical serves the cardiovascular, neurovascular, robotic surgery, gastrointestinal, and minimally invasive surgery markets. Its customer base includes major original equipment manufacturers as well as tier 2 and tier 3 suppliers.

The company emphasizes vertical integration to deliver speed to market, seamless communication through a dedicated project engineer from design for manufacture through validation, and guaranteed consistency via a quality culture that cross‑trains all employees on critical quality principles.
